decisions.reason: Shop-to-retail-system interfaces remain a lasting integration need that uses the firm's plugin development strengths and binds clients through ongoing maintenance.
Relaunch SEO support costs little to offer, ties directly into the firm's core relaunch projects and still has its own dedicated page.
SEO workshops are a new, low-cost service presented on their own page that brings in leads for the firm's marketing services, so dropping them after one year would be premature.
